column3: Secret Missions: optional finds by reported chapter. Right toggles checkmarks in the list; OK opens details and Check/Uncheck toggles status. Progress saves on SD. Chapter gates marked ? are uncertain.
Safe & Door Codes: browse published numeric codes and passwords by type. [?] marks less-corroborated, conflicting or potentially changing reports. Ordinary robbery safes often have a random code.

Bridges, Cars, Stunts and Collections: each listed entry can be marked Completed. Right toggles a checkmark in its list; OK opens details, with Check/Undo at center. Progress saves to SD and reloads automatically.

Press Right (Emulate) to start the best map or link immediately. GTA6GPS maps come first. Press OK during NFC to browse multiple links, then Up/Down and OK to select. Tap your unlocked phone. Back stops NFC and returns to the checklist with the item highlighted.

Under the Bridge and Stunt Jumps are grouped by county in Collections; Knife Flights and Base Jumps are there too (397 stunts total). Cars include Randy, Moses, Wyman and Standout Vehicles. Collections include cards, scans, flamingos and other finds. Any 300 stunts count toward 100%. A single successful bridge pass or stunt jump gives completion credit; map-icon bonus objectives are optional. Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots: purple = found, white = completed. PowerPyx reports Lapwing Mallard fits all bridges; try night hours 22:00–05:00 for lighter road traffic. Remain airborne, avoid touching water/structure. 250 stunts for trophy; 300 for 100%. Bridge route numbers are guide order, not game IDs.
Standout roster additions (reported variants, tracked IDs 5222-5238):
Lagoon Schafter: Ocean Beach container; Street Racer; speed 7.6, acceleration 7.5, handling 4.5. Separate from Nightlight.
Burning Cypher: Port Gellhorn container; Stock Car; speed 8, acceleration 8.3, handling 5.2. Separate from Bareback and Pop Art.
Status RSX: Gellhorn Raceway recovery truck; Stock Car; speed 8.7, acceleration 8.7, handling 7; reported registration $40,650, sale $10,655.
Highwayman Sanchez: Billy robbery story bike; Race Bikes; retention not verified.
Smokescreen Carbon RS: Port Gellhorn building-site container; Race Bikes; speed 7, acceleration 8, handling 7.6. Not Hung Carbon RS.
Bullion Gauntlet: Millport cargo container; Ripped & Shredded.
Beast Chino: Lake Tallaloko luxury resort; Retro; exact parking spot not verified.
Dogfight FCR: VCIA flight school; Retro; aviation styling, not Booty FCR 1000.
Obsidian Sovereign: Draper Island shipping container; Retro; not Peacock or Blood Fever.
Raul's Coquette Classic: Ocean Beach marina; Retro; distinct from ordinary 1964 Coquette in published variant lists.
AudaCity Sanchez: Chapter 3 Trial by Tire, La Perle parking garage; use during mission, retention not verified.
AudaCity Sandking: Chapter 3 Quit Your Job, Sell Your House; after hospital drop-off keep or sell. Alternate Vice City Sign stunt: Key Cloner, alarm, no tracker. Reported registration $4,400.
Interdimensional Youga: Abandoned in Mount Kalaga National Park; Fine Art; separate from Third Eye at Grayson.
Lacewing Maverick: Crosstown rooftop; Law & Order; exact roof access not verified.
Independence Boomazoom: Bar by Lake Leonida; Americana-style livery; exact bar unverified.
Sandblasted Cliffhanger: Breakwater Quarry container corroborated by GTABase and GTA Town; All-Terrain; distinct from Magma.
Chrome Street Blazer: Roadside cargo crate, Port Gellhorn; All-Terrain; distinct from Azalea and Tormentor.
Basketball: the illustrated route documents four Hamlet Prison hoops (two per yard), two Washington Beach roof hoops, three on an Ocean Beach roof and two four-hoop underpass clusters. Score each hoop separately. Some GPS-to-route numbers remain unmatched.

Cocaine Flamingos: destroy the figures with BLACK-WHITE beaks. Black-yellow beaks are decorative; collecting loose cocaine is optional. 103 dedicated records and 48 provisional leads; overlapping reports are not 125 verified unique pickups; 100 of 125 count for 100% completion. Verify the game counter at uncertain map stops.

Magazine Styles: scan with the phone, switch to Jason/Lucia for character-specific unlocks, and inspect private houses when clues point inside.

Scan style and tattoo magazines with WAiNK. Collect watches directly. Reported milestones: 10 watches unlock Move Time Forward; 20 unlock Pause Time of Day. 70 of 79 styles count toward 100%.

Vice City Hustle (Nov 26) reports that collectible watches unlock wardrobe accessories rather than fence proceeds. If all 45 other styles are collected, at least 25 of the 34 watches are still required to reach 70 styles. Missed gang-operation valuables may be recoverable on a later respawn; check the collection counter.
Push Square: after scanning, buy the style at a salon or tattoo shop. Hair is under Magazine Styles; tattoo under Awards for the correct body part. Scan unlock does not require purchase for discovery credit (reported).

The reported full magazine rosters are in Jason Magazine Roster and Lucia Magazine Roster. Some styles have guide directions only, without checkmarks. See Collections for tracked entries. The 17 tattoo and 34 watch identities are not fully reconciled.
Collected watch models are reportedly available under wardrobe Accessories > Watches; do not confuse acquisition with pawn-shop sale proceeds.

Diving: Island Dreams unlocks diving. Bring scuba gear, choose the metal detector from lower-right weapon wheel, follow chest markers and dig once light turns GREEN. The nearby wrecks southeast of Key Lento can be visited together.

Optional Missions are a separate Collections checklist; Cal and Kirk already appear in Secret Missions. Messages in Bottles are optional reading, not part of 34 books and swaps. Extra unique weapon names are guide-reported, not game-verified.

Meteorites: 83 checklist records; GTADB 50 search areas and GTA6GPS 49 markers audited Nov 27. No verified global total or mandatory 100% quota. Sell to participating pawn shops or Kenton after contact unlock (reported). Cave and trench pins can be shared; mark only distinct pickups. Unassigned GTA6GPS leads: fresh impact 918960; Buck Creek broken bridge 918961 (possible random); Boiled Peanuts bicycles 918963; Steel Drop 918966/918968 (possible duplicate); Lummox rocks 918969; red pool pair 918958; Wonder Whale submerged toilet 918967. Use the meteorite category map to inspect these; no separate checklist IDs. Full cross-reference in README.

Strangers & Freaks: complete the eight reported qualifying strands: Merle (Final Flush), Freddie (Retest), Kirk (Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Buddy?), Alvan (Missing Person), Yago (Brother to Brother), Papa Audacity (The Audacity), Pilot Pete (last delivery). Credit is at the strand finale; verify the trophy counter. Other strands can have separate trophies. Shirley’s errands, Yago’s limited race and Shayna’s ride are time-sensitive; Yasmani’s one-day ATM tip and optional Gold Blammer/small-bank jobs may also be missed without blocking his later jobs. Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase and Alcast.
Stick Ups: 107 venue leads reconcile to a 107-store fan directory, NOT the 91 tracked targets. Nov 26 map-menu guide documents a 33-entry snapshot; 32 match existing records and one unnumbered Grassrivers Xero remains ambiguous. Two cards omit take/security. The guide reports unlock after Girls’ Trip (Ch2); check the in-game map and counter.
Meteorite directory comparison: GTABase reports 117 markers, WikiGTAVI 89. Marker totals may include duplicates or unverified sites; neither is a verified global collectible total. Existing 83 records are not expanded without collision verification.
Meteorite map audit: Tildrix now lists 111 markers; WikiGTAVI 89 and GTABase 117. These are provider coverage counts, not a verified in-game total. The decoded-save collectible table inspected has no meteorite-fragment family. Do not use the 130 figure from unrelated map comments as a confirmed count.

Missables: keep a manual save before Tourist Trap (C1) and Checking Out (C2). In C2 pay Linda before Slam Dunk, collect Starlet Motel cards and books, and help Wyman at his car before moving. In C3 take Gil's pistol in Safe Word and Monty's pistol in The Missing Link. Pete's rifle is a C4 mission pickup.

Chapter 2: finish Girl's Trip and start Take a Vehicle to Moses as Lucia. Keep the first registration unused. WAiNK-scan a candidate: tracker NONE, eligible and a free garage slot. Drive to Watkins Auto Parts, Port Gellhorn. Complete Moses' tutorial. If prompted, choose Find Another instead of spending the waiver on the tutorial car. Bring the car you want. Open Services (PS5: L2 then Square; Xbox: LT then X), Respray, then Register. Both first services should show FREE. Confirm ownership and check Scooter Bros.\n\nBison: reported 6 cargo slots; Dominator: 2. Montagne XL waits behind Watkins. Choose a useful cargo vehicle or save the waiver for a high-value car (see Free Thrax glitch). Subsequent registrations normally cost money; no reproducible unlimited free method established. Chapter 3 Pay 'n' Spray reportedly accepts Standard trackers after story unlock; Advanced tracker registration: complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, progress Randy's Wish List, finish Dale Mamba and receive Randy's call. Key Cloner alone is not enough. GTABase (Nov 24) corroborates the one-time free offer, and reports Advanced tracker registration in Chapter 4; check actual Randy progression and Register availability before relying on an earlier unlock.

Community-reported Chapter 2 exploit, not unlimited free registrations. Keep Moses' Find a suitable vehicle objective active and the one-time waiver unused. Save separately.

1. As Lucia, visit the modern white mansion off Sabal Circle, southern Starfish Island, just past the figure-eight driveway. A Rosy Palms pickup is reported nearby.
2. Angle the pickup along the right garage door, leaving a narrow gap. Squeeze into it; crouch (Circle/B), move toward door and open phone (D-pad Up). Adjust position and retry. If you fall through the map, reload.
3. Once inside, close phone, use Open at the center post and drive out in Andrew Node's Thrax. WAiNK-scan for tracker and eligibility.
4. Return to Watkins Auto Parts, finish Slim Jim tutorial if needed, respray and register only if FREE. Normally $70,000; unique name/paint may change.

If waiver already used, Chapter 3 No Flusher route unlocks the garage normally but registration costs money. Reported Nov 23-25; may be patched. See Standout Vehicles > Andrew Node's Thrax for map and normal route.

Nov 25 tracker recheck lists the method as still reported, but has no submitted player tests. Treat as an exploit report, not proof of current build compatibility.

Community-reported Story Mode exploit (B Man, Nov 24; Xbox 1.0.2.2). Not independently tested on PS5. Save to a separate slot.

1. Go to Apollo Aggregates east of Hamlet. Bring a registered car with two stash slots and both playable characters unlocked. Prepare one full bag and one nearly empty bag.
2. Take the FULL bag out first, then the nearly empty one. At the loot van, repeatedly use ONLY the side with the paired Collect prompts. Avoid the single-item prompt: it may fill the wrong bag and break the method.
3. Stow both bags, switch characters and back to reset warehouse loot. Retrieve full bag first and repeat. Check the actual bag value after each pass. The published demonstration used four loot vans; whether duplicating them is necessary is not established.
4. Sell a small test load first. Tyrone (C3) is the reported buyer for the large sale. A video shows over $100,000 in one bag and roughly $116,000 sale; neither is guaranteed. Keep enough BuckMe headroom for the entire pending payout. Check real credited balance, not just bag UI.

Smaller alternative (single player report): at $8,400 bag value, quickly collect two adjacent cocaine pickups; reported $10,800 instead of $9,600. Capacities vary by contents. If overfill fails, use normal warehouse loop. See Infinite Money Glitch > Map.

Nov 25 tracker recheck lists this as reported working, without submitted player tests. The normal save/reload warehouse route has stronger post-patch evidence than the single-bag overflow.

Experimental separate method (Bubs, Nov 24): a stuck trunk count is not the same as overfilling one bag. At Apollo Aggregates, fill an available 10-slot van and your registered car. Drive the van to Dunk and unload all bags by hand. Bring your registered car up and remove two bags. If the count stays unchanged (reported 3/4), try a small additional sale and verify actual bank credit. Payout can be zero or inconsistent. Unregistered van variant is risky: never rely on its cargo persisting through save/reload. The existing two-owned-car route is safer for normal loot storage. Keep a backup; stop if not credited.\n\nNov 25 tracker lists the method but records no submitted player tests; the frozen counter alone does not demonstrate a successful payout.

Max Focus stat farming (not Unlimited Focus cheat). Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range, northeast Port Gellhorn (Kelly County). Save first. Pay $5 waiver at clerk; choose Market Range Beginner. Use pistol (rental if needed). Clear six targets, about 5 seconds. At results choose Quit and exit to range, then start the challenge fresh. Do NOT choose Restart: community video reports the stat gain is credited on exit.

Repeat until purple eye Focus reaches Level 4 / max in Jason & Lucia > character profile. About 5% per run is a creator estimate, not guaranteed. Check before and after a few runs. Train other character separately after Coffee Break (C2). Focus increases duration of combat slow-motion (L3+R3); it is not permanently infinite. No cheat activation. PowerPyx corroborates this repeatable course; Nov 23 patch notes did not mention it. See Shooting Gold Medals > Market - Beginner for map.

Nov 25 tracker recheck lists the course method as reported working; no independent player tests are recorded there.
Dispatch: select a region. OK checks or undoes the stop. Left (Next) advances to the next unchecked stop. Right (Emulate) opens the location reference when available. Back returns to the region menu.

61 reported effects; [?] = input unavailable.\n\n21 main-catalog sequences per platform are retained. GTA6DB reports PS5 activation footage for $250,000, Unlimited Focus, Attack Force and HVY Bulldozer, plus the Exploding Balls menu input. Xbox sequences are outlet reports or conversions, not independently tested. Videotape Xbox input is a conversion with a conflicting report. Pinhole remains single-source.

To use: finish the story and the individual cheat's unlock challenge. Check Progress > Cheats. In free roam press D-pad Up to open phone. Hold L1 and R1 (PS5) or LB and RB (Xbox), then enter the D-pad code.

Save before cheats: outlets report no saving or trophies/achievements once a cheat is active in that session. Story Mode only. A Nov 24 PS5 recording reportedly shows the $250,000 activation warning: saving and trophies are unavailable for that session. Keep a separate pre-cheat save; restart the game and load it before continuing normal progress.

Test source: 28 PlayStation controller sequences transcribed, not GTA VI-tested. 24 screenshot-only entries show their sequences in Unverified codes. Four matching effects show the test input as an alternate in the main catalog. Effect matches do NOT verify the test inputs. Xbox equivalents are button-label conversions, not separately sourced codes. TRI=Triangle CIR=Circle SQR=Square; U/D/L/R=direction.

Reported Animals menu: 255 entries; study any 100 for 100% progress. Use binoculars and hold the study button (R1/RB). Aquatic species can be studied by swimming nearby when prompted. Landing fish is a separate activity. Buy lures from fishing-equipped Ammu-Nation stores. Fish pages distinguish reported fish size from lure size; a large fish may take a small lure. F=freshwater; S=saltwater. s/M/L=small/medium/large. ?=not documented. Hunt pages give reported habitat and recommended in-game weapon; use the in-game prompt if sources differ. Eight unique hunts also appear in the existing tracked catalog. All eight Animals categories have reference rosters. Read-only guide: no new checklist IDs. Community map: vice-city.app/map > Animals > species. Points are community map markers, not a guarantee of a live spawn; use the listed species label. Reported sites are guide leads.
The 35-species fishing roster is separate from successful catches for Sports challenges. Study aquatic animals by holding R1/RB when the prompt appears; use a rod for actual catches.
Published IGN-derived comparison puts three mutant species at Tortoise Head Power Plant, southeast Hamlet, and reports a second possible duck search area south of Belville. Nine Other Animals still lack documented encounter locations.
Fishing shops: fish icon on map. Small lures are available early; medium freshwater $45, medium saltwater $56. Large saltwater lure $125 reportedly unlocks in Chapter 3; earlier shop listing may say sold out. D-pad Right changes lures. Fish Log updates when you land a fish.

Reported optional encounter (By Invitation Only); earliest story gate unconfirmed. Capri pavilion on Beacon Circle, by Bean Machine and gold-painted performer. If officer approaches, interrupt conversation until arrest, then surrender; alternatively bump performer, converse with officers, later surrender to Capri police. Cage escape prompt Square (PS5) / X (Xbox); recover cage keys, reclaim equipment and CPD Moreland 850 from open police-car trunk; free remaining prisoners.

Reference only; not additional checklist IDs.

Clock Out: after Day Release, Jason accepts Lucia's call; pick her up at community center by 16:00 in a vehicle, then drive home. Missable.

Donnie's Lost Drugs: after Swamped, dive southeast portion of search area north of Key Lento, open boat stern compartment and deliver to Brian for $1,200.

Impounded Vehicle: after Coffee Break, collect Lucia's car at Port Gellhorn police lot and clear two-star pursuit.

Get Your Wheels: after Dealer's Choice, recover one impounded car through Scooter Bros or register a replacement with a free garage slot.

Reference only; not additional checklist IDs.

It's a Date!: after Heavy Lifting, bring both characters to Courtyard Bar in Stockyard, buy a drink and exit; relationship benefit.

Bad Driver!: after Party Hard, finish before Power Play. Chase Felipe from Millport bar; killing reportedly pays $20,000, sparing unlocks a later car gift instead.

Dre'Quan's Gift: several days after Photo/Shoot, either character can collect KD's SFB 1000 from alley behind La Perle Pay n Spray.

Story safehouses unlock through the story. Published guides report no house purchases or passive-income businesses in Story Mode. Garages are purchasable; use the Vice City Real Estate phone app when unlocked. Eight purchasable garages cost $160,000 total. Check Garages for exact costs and storage. The Starlet Motel is temporary rented accommodation, not property ownership. Del Rio Boulevard is an additional free hidden garage unlocked via the Chapter 3 laptop and keypad; it is not one of the eight purchases.\nRandy’s post-Delivery Day Tempesta collection reportedly includes access to the one-slot Domestic Timbers garage in Balsero. See the Randy finale guide.

Pool: 17 tables are reported: 10 solo and 7 with opponents. Win at any 5 distinct opponent venues for 100%; beat all 7 for a reported tattoo. A story match that ends early is not necessarily an opponent win. Pool practice raises Focus. Sports challenges: Pool Streak is 3 venues in one day without a loss or quit; Triple Bank and 8-Ball Break are separate. Golf: complete two different mini-golf courses for 100%; Golf Pro requires the 18-hole King Gator and Frontier rounds in the same day at par or better. Full golf is separate. Tennis: courts are mapped, but a scored opponent match has not been established in the reviewed guides.

Chapter 3: finish Randy’s active wishlist, Dale Mamba and Mansion Thrax. Wait about a day for Randy’s call. Either character can meet him at the Balsero showroom. Escort him and protect the cars in the delivery mission. Reported reward: $25,000 and Supply & Demand trophy.
After his next text, retrieve Raul’s Tempesta from Domestic Timbers garage in Balsero; one garage slot, $11,600 reported registration, $27,150 reported resale in good condition.

Original board: 15 cars plus story Zorrusso (16 tracker entries). Mamba and Thrax are separate later missions; Coquette D10 is a reported later request. Cypher, Carbonizzare and Neon are crossed-out candidates in some sources. The app tracks 22 reported requests/sightings, not 22 mandatory deliveries. Talk to Randy for new hints; seven board spawns are tip-gated. Supply & Demand is awarded at Delivery Day, not simply upon the last board car.

After Island Dreams, complete the two initial sets and sell them to Kenton. Complete Check in with Kenton, then search and sell the next three sets. Maritime Dispute requires Chapter 3 Jason and prior Kenton progress; finish it to access the final two sites. Published thresholds differ. Use a scuba-equipped boat from Watson Bay or Capri.
Check Progress > Contacts > Kenton Rees > Shipwrecks Cleared. Purple chest markers show outstanding finds. Seven sets contain 41 relics; Del Ocio’s 10 Gold Doubloons are separate. For 100%, clear five of seven Kenton sets and all 33 Exploration discoveries. The five named treasure wrecks plus Del Ocio give six discovery entries; Belpoint Strait and Bobcat are reported treasure-only. Confirm the two counters separately.
For a missing piece, open Progress > Collections > Kenton’s Treasures, select its named site and use the detector; buried chests must be pulled free and opened. Return to Island Dreams Boat Charters, focus on Kenton (L2/LT), select Treasures (Circle/B). Check BuckMe after any later buyer text; do not count counter payment twice.
Underwater: all 33 named locations have individual map references. Track Progress > Collections > Exploration > Points of Interest > Underwater Discoveries. Passenger Jet and Sailboat have mapped wreck evidence but no readable credit notification in the reviewed video. Verify their own counters before leaving.

Frampton Island: northeast of Lummox; hillside bunker keypad 3612. Bring a flashlight. Reward and connection to Final Flush are unverified.\nDecor District: warehouse north of Stockyard, MVP PARKING sign. A late-night Jason encounter around 02:39 reportedly triggers robot dolls; check the rear for Chastity and the reported Zombix pickup. Exact trigger unknown.\nRelationship tip: as Jason, approach the front passenger door when Lucia is with you; if Open for Lucia appears, hold Triangle/Y. A small relationship benefit is reported; no verified numerical gain.

Ambergris Torlan (Calder, Blinged Up): search a boathouse in Waning Sands, Leonard County; gold hull. See GTA Town and GTABase vehicle pages linked in README.
Flipside Enduro (Dinka, All-Terrain): Mount Kalaga, Lummox County; reported fixed shipping-container spawn. Two seats; GTA Town reports speed 3.9, acceleration 5.7, asphalt handling 5.2, off-road handling 7.6 and strength 4.0 (all /10). Its Mount Kalaga map is an area anchor, not an exact container pin.
Bret's Rebel (Karin, All-Terrain): 1984 hunting pickup; reward for work for Bret / Killtelligence Provisions. Exact handover and retention timing not established.
These three named variants are not tracked by separate IDs in this build. Existing records must not be repurposed, and the full live source must be checked before new IDs are assigned.

Bret’s Rebel is a hunting reward from Killtelligence Provisions, as independently corroborated by the hunting activity guide; exact grant stage still not established. Three variants remain unallocated pending full live-tree verification.
